description: Diagnose connectivity issues between a source service and a target resource. Checks Vercel environment variables, AWS Security Group inbound rules on the required port, and external API reachability. Returns a list of diagnostic results with actionable messages.

port.description: TCP port to verify access on. Auto-detected from common resource types when omitted.

s3_origin.description: When target is aws-s3, check CORS for this origin (e.g. 'https://my-app.pages.dev').

source_service.description: The origin service that initiates the connection.

target_resource.description: The resource to connect to. Format: '<type>:<identifier>'. Examples: 'aws-rds:my-db', 'aws-lambda:my-function', 'external-api:https://api.example.com'

vercel_project.description: Vercel project name or ID for env-var checks.

name: diagnose_service_link
